title: Evidence Standard for an Approved Correction — Travel Protection Plans
content:
A re-rated difference on a Travel Protection Plans certificate is taken at a share which the evidence behind the correction carries. Two records decide it: whether the approved correction carries the reference of the evidence the policyholder supplied, and whether the ledger of the linked vacation package, one of the Vacation Package Products, carries a line settling the balance of the package.

Where the approved correction carries the reference of the evidence the policyholder supplied and the linked package's ledger carries a line settling the balance of the package, the share the evidence behind the correction carries is the whole of it, 100 per cent.

Where the approved correction carries the reference of the evidence the policyholder supplied and the linked package's ledger carries no line settling the balance, the share the evidence behind the correction carries is 85 per cent.

Where neither holds, the share the evidence behind the correction carries is 60 per cent.

## The graded share

| The approved correction | The linked package's ledger | Share the evidence carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Carries the reference of the evidence the policyholder supplied | Carries a line settling the balance | 100 per cent |
| Carries the reference of the evidence the policyholder supplied | Carries no line settling the balance | 85 per cent |
| Carries no such reference | Either way | 60 per cent |

## Cases

A case at the whole share: the underwriting desk's approved correction names the evidence the policyholder supplied, and the package's ledger shows the balance of the package settled. The difference is carried into the calculation undiminished by this share, at 100 per cent.

A case at the middle share: the approved correction names that evidence, but the package's balance has not been settled on its ledger. The share is 85 per cent.

A case at the lowest share: the approved correction carries no reference for the evidence supplied. The share is 60 per cent, and the state of the package's ledger makes no difference, because both of the higher cases require the evidence reference before the ledger is looked at.

Hypothetically, on a difference of 200.00 USD after apportionment, the three shares give 200.00 USD, 170.00 USD and 120.00 USD respectively.
